WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT r.name, SUM(COALESCE(CAST(res.points AS REAL), 0)) AS total_points
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), above_average AS (
  SELECT name, total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
  WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)
), selected_results AS (
  SELECT a.total_points, CAST(res.laps AS REAL) AS laps
  FROM above_average AS a
  JOIN races AS r ON r.name = a.name
  JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
)
SELECT SUM(total_points) AS combined_total_points,
       AVG(laps) AS average_laps_completed,
       AVG(total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)) AS average_excess_points
FROM selected_results;
